g.text: (b) Δv when ⅔ of the mass is propellant
Ideal rocket equation, v_e = g₀ I_sp. Reference Δv values: Hohmann transfer from 400 km LEO to a 1-sol Mars orbit (this chapter's model);
Dawn ≈ 11 km/s; 70-day trip from the power-limited model in this chapter.
